paper_title: Feedback Friction LLMs Struggle to Fully Incorporate External Feedback
caption: Comparison of the Improvement for 5-digit and 6-digit multiplication with as feedback model
model_annotation: The plot titled “Accuracy Improvement Over Iterations” illustrates how accuracy (in percent) changes across iterative steps for two conditions labeled “6-digit” and “5-digit.” The x-axis is labeled “Iteration,” uses a linear scale, and runs from 0 to 9 with integer tick marks at every 1 iteration. The y-axis is labeled “Accuracy (%)”, uses a linear scale, and spans approximately 0 to 100 with major ticks shown at regular 20-point intervals (0, 20, 40, 60, 80, 100). Two lines are shown: the “6-digit” series is a blue solid line with circular markers, starting near 1% at iteration 0, rising to about 37% at iteration 1, about 69% at iteration 2, about 82% at iteration 3, then increasing more gradually through about 88% (iteration 4), ~90% (5), ~91% (6), ~92% (7), ~92% (8), and ending near 94% at iteration 9. The “5-digit” series is an orange solid line with square markers, starting near 2% at iteration 0, increasing to about 67% at iteration 1 and ~79% at iteration 2, reaching about 83% at iteration 3, then continuing with smaller increments at roughly 84% (iteration 4), ~85% (5), ~86% (6), ~87% (7), ~88% (8), and ending near 90% at iteration 9.
